svg.title: Clocked wavefront observatory for a three by three output-stationary MXU
svg.desc: Conceptual cycle trace, not a physical accelerator floorplan. Blue A packets move right and amber B packets move down through nine crosspoint processing elements. Each node locks three accumulator arcs, white phase rings mark synchronized MAC events, and teal contacts close in a one two three two one anti-diagonal ready wave. The active MAC envelope is one three six seven six three one.
